description: This course provides an in-depth introduction to the emerging field of Deep Generative Models (DGMs) through readings, seminars, and practical exercises. It explores the probabilistic foundations, training methodologies, and inference algorithms of key generative families, including Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), Normalizing Flows, Autoregressive Models, and Diffusion Models. Students will study both exact and approximate inference algorithms, alongside modern learning techniques for complex data generation. By bridging theoretical principles with hands-on applications, this course prepares students to navigate and apply recent methods in this rapidly developing area.
